services.name: Photography Tour
services.desc: Person: $35 2 Hours Description This 2 hour tour through the privately-owned Santa Margarita Ranch will give you a chance to photograph several of California’s most scenic landscapes. All you need is a camera for this tour and our Ranch Naturalist Jacqueline Redinger will lead you from location to location through oak woodlands, savannah grasslands, California chaparral, rustic farmland, ancient sea beds with giant fossilized oyster shells, and vineyard vines. You may also get a chance to spot and photograph some of our natural wildlife including deer, turkeys, bears, eagles 2 Hours

services.name: Ranch Tour
services.desc: Experience a guided offroad immersion into the natural world of the historic Santa Margarita Ranch. This visually spectacular tour leads you into the diverse Santa Lucia mountain range in one of our open-air Kawasaki Mule off-road vehicles. Along the way, our ranch naturalist will discuss native ecosystems and plants; the local wildlife, including bears, eagles, mountain lions, turkeys and more; foraging and uses of natural materials; and the remarkable history of the ranch and the town of Santa Margarita. This 2 hour tour will ultimately open your eyes to one of the Central Coast’s Explore the Back Roads! • 2 hours • All ages

services.name: Eagle Tour
services.desc: Come learn about a few common bird species that live on the Santa Margarita Ranch, with a focus on Bald Eagles, Golden Eagles, and Red-tailed Hawks. Together, we will take a walk on the wild side while we gain an understanding of the role that these organisms play in the Ranch ecosystem. We will learn how to identify these birds using sight and sound and find out why they are so famous. Let's uncover some of the mystery surrounding their lives! This tour includes a scenic ¾-mile hike with minimal elevation gain. If you have mobility concerns, we can happily accommodate as long as 1.5 Hours • All Ages

services.name: Foraging Tour
services.desc: Foraging has been a part of Native Californian peoples’ health, well-being and survival for thousands of years. Many plants found on Santa Margarita Ranch carry a strong historical significance, and we embrace foraging as a cultural practice that remains relevant in this modern age. Join us as we take you on a journey through time and nature to discover a variety of plants that can be used for nutrition, beverages and other healthful purposes. Along the way, we will educate you on what plants to avoid, and we will teach you mindful enjoyment of the environment no matter where you spend 2.5 Hours • Ages 8+

services.name: Breast Cancer Awareness Vineyard Walk
services.desc: We invite you to walk through the vineyard on Santa Margarita Ranch to raise funds for Breast Cancer Awareness on Sunday, October 22, 2023. Wear pink and walk a 2-mile loop through Margarita Vineyard! Following the walk, enjoy tacos provided by La Parilla and a complimentary glass of rosé (21+). Proceeds will be donated to the Cancer Support Community of the Central Coast. This event is for all ages, and is stroller-friendly! No pets please. Price $50 per person Adult (age 13+) $10 per youth (age 12 and under) You ticket is considered a donation and will be non-refundable. All Proceeds All ages • 2 hours • Proceeds will be donated

services.name: Escape Together! <3
services.desc: Come Celebrate Valentine's Day at Escape! at Margarita Adventures! Getting in is easy—but do you and your special someone have what it takes to escape? Put your creativity and ingenuity to the test as you both encounter one surprise after another. Included in this package is wine tasting at Ancient Peaks Winery, either before or after your Escape Room Experience. You will get the opportunity to taste 5 Estate wines and share a house made Chocolate Crème Brûlée. Available February 10th-14th. Don't wait! Surprise that special someone today! Double Dates are Encouraged!! NOW AVAILABLE: Rita's Valentines Day Package

services.name: eBike Vineyard Tour
services.desc: At Margarita Adventures, we offer a uniquely thrilling perspective on a true California landmark—the historic Santa Margarita Ranch in the Paso Robles wine country. Here, you will embark on a 2 hour journey on peddle-assist eBikes through the Margarita Vineyard. Along the way, you will learn about the ranch’s sustainable winegrowing practices and role as part of California’s famed Mission Trail. Find out what makes Ancient Peaks Wine so special, from the 5 different soil types found in the Margarita Vineyard, to various microclimates. Take a moment to take in the Explore the Margarita Vineyards on e-Bikes! • 2 hours

services.name: California Wild Kids Camp
services.desc: Kids Camp Description: If you’re looking for a fun and educational environment for your child to explore, look no further than our California Wild Kids Camps. These experiences showcase the natural wonder of the Santa Margarita Ranch and will feature crafting, games, wildlife, and more! Each camp session will feature new experiences and will be an opportunity for kids to meet new friends and gain an appreciation for the natural environment that surrounds us. Upcoming Sessions and Dates Spring Camp 2025 Dates: April 14th, 16th, 18th Times: Full Days (9am-3:00pm) | Half Days (9am-12:30pm) Ages 7 - 11 years • Half day & full day camps
